C1139.title: Bybit Stolen Funds Laundered Through Mixer eXch
C1139.summary: In February 2025, exchange Bybit suffered a hack resulting in a massive ETH theft. On-chain investigators discovered that the hacker laundered at least 29,000 ETH through eXch, a centralized mixer requiring no KYC, and bridged the funds to Bitcoin. eXch publicly refused to assist Bybit in recovering the funds, citing its commitment to decentralization.
